purpose: the 26 MiB transport boundary, under side: a framed body of exactly 27262976 bytes passes the transport, and the envelope refuses it with byte_size <= 26214400
pre_authorization: Captured before the T-6 reseal. Every request here is unauthenticated and is answered. This is not a post-auth expectation.

request.body_note: a framed multipart body of exactly 27262976 bytes, built in process; no fixture is added to the repository

body.text: {"contract_version": "1.0.0-draft.1", "error_code": "validation_failed", "message": "The upload payload is larger than the accepted envelope allows.", "correlation_id": "{{correlation_id}}", "retryable": false, "details": {"field": "content", "constraint": "byte_size <= 26214400"}}

tokens.{{content_length}}: a function of the body, which is compared byte for byte; the comparison asserts Content-Length == str(len(body)) separately
tokens.{{correlation_id}}: assigned by the edge because the request carried none; checked against the pinned CorrelationId shape before being tokenised
tokens.{{session_tag}}: this capture run's tag, carried by every idempotency key
